##### Project general facts

Warsan Village is a family-oriented residential community located in the southwestern part of International City, offering a collection of modern three-bedroom townhouses set within a peaceful, landscaped environment. The development features 934 homes surrounded by lush green spaces and connected by tree-lined avenues, creating a comfortable and tranquil setting designed for everyday family living.

The community is fully self-contained, providing a wide range of amenities to support a convenient lifestyle. Residents have access to shops, cafés, restaurants, and a community clubhouse, as well as the nearby Warsan Souk — a vibrant retail destination with numerous outlets, dining options, and essential services. Additional retail and leisure facilities are available at the nearby International City Pavilion, ensuring all daily needs are within easy reach.

The townhouses are designed in a contemporary style with spacious layouts that maximise natural light and functionality. Each home features large living areas, generously sized bedrooms, terraces, and extensive glazing that enhances indoor-outdoor living. Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, including ceramic and stone flooring, built-in wardrobes, and well-appointed bathrooms. Kitchens are fully fitted, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

International City is a diverse and multicultural community situated in Dubai. This unique development spans over 300 hectares and is designed to represent a melting pot of various global cultures, making it a truly global village within the city. Each district within International City is named after a different country and is characterized by its distinct architectural styles, bringing an authentic touch of these cultures to Dubai. From Chinese-inspired buildings in China Cluster to European-themed structures in France Cluster, residents and visitors can experience a glimpse of different parts of the world in this cosmopolitan community.

The community fosters a vibrant and lively atmosphere, with its bustling retail areas, diverse dining options, and regular cultural events. Residents can indulge in an array of culinary delights from different cuisines, shop for unique goods, and immerse themselves in a vibrant and eclectic ambiance.

International City's strategic location provides easy access to major transportation routes, connecting residents to other key areas of Dubai. Its proximity to the Dubai International Airport and other major landmarks further enhances its appeal, making it a preferred choice for many expatriates and locals alike.
